description: This Python module defines a controller class 'UserIdleController' for managing user idle detection in a conversational system. It handles user activity frames, tracks conversation state, manages asynchronous tasks, and triggers an event when the user has been idle for a specified timeout.

classes.name: UserIdleController
classes.description: A controller class for managing user idle detection, monitoring user activity, handling function call states, and triggering an idle event after a timeout.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the UserIdleController with a specified user idle timeout.

methods.name: task_manager
methods.description: Property that returns the configured task manager, raises error if not set.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Associates a task manager with the controller and starts the idle task.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up the controller, cancelling the idle task.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames to update conversation and activity state.

methods.name: _handle_activity
methods.description: Handles continuous activity frames to reset idle timer.

methods.name: _handle_function_calls_started
methods.description: Handles start of function calls, setting in-progress state.

methods.name: _handle_function_call_result
methods.description: Handles end of function calls, clearing in-progress state.

methods.name: user_idle_task_handler
methods.description: Asynchronous loop that waits for idle timeout and triggers 'on_user_turn_idle' event.
